Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Alok Kumar, learned counsel
for the applicant.
2. Mr. Rakesh Joshi, learned A.G.A.
along with Mr. Manoj Bhatt, learned
Brief Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Faizan Ali, learned counsel for
the complainant.
4. By means of the present
application, the applicant seeks
anticipatory bail in connection with the
Case Crime No.180 of 2025, registered at
Police Station-Bhagwanpur, District
Haridwar under Section 69 of the B.N.S.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant
would submit that according to the FIR,
the applicant under the pretext of
marriage has made physical relations
with the sister of the informant for the
last three years. He would further
submit that the applicant is innocent
and has falsely been implicated in the
present case; that, the applicant was
engaged with the sister of the informant
in the year 2023, but after engagement,
the applicant found that the alleged
victim is in a relationship with one

UKHC010079172025
2026:UHC:8819
Mohsin.
6. Learned counsel for the applicant
would submit that the investigation has
been completed and the charge-sheet
has already been submitted before the
competent court. He would further
submit that the Coordinate Bench of this
Court, vide order dated 10.06.2025, had
granted interim protection from arrest to
the applicant; that, pursuant thereto, the
applicant has remained available to the
Investigating Officer and has extended
full cooperation during the course of
investigation. It is further submitted that
the investigation having culminated in
filing of the charge-sheet, no further
custodial interrogation of the applicant is
warranted. Learned counsel, therefore,
prays that the interim anticipatory bail
granted to the applicant on 10.06.2025
be made absolute.
7. Learned State Counsel, however,
would oppose the prayer for anticipatory
bail and submit that the allegations
made in the F.I.R. are serious in nature.
Nevertheless, it is not disputed that the
applicant has remained protected from
arrest pursuant to the interim order
dated 10.06.2025.
8. Having heard learned counsel for
the parties and upon perusal of the
material available on record, this Court
finds that the applicant has remained
under the protection of this Court
pursuant to the interim order dated
10.06.2025. There is nothing on record
to indicate that, during the subsistence
of the said protection, the applicant has
misused the liberty granted to him or
has failed to cooperate with the
investigation. On the contrary, the

UKHC010079172025
2026:UHC:8819
investigation has already been concluded
and the charge-sheet has been
submitted before the competent court.
9. Once the investigation has
culminated in the filing of the charge-sheet, the matter has substantially
progressed beyond the stage of
investigation. No material has been
brought on record by the prosecution to
demonstrate that the custodial
interrogation of the applicant is presently
required for any further purpose. It is
also relevant that the applicant has
remained available to the Investigating
Officer during the period of interim
protection and has subjected himself to
the process of investigation.
10. This Court is also conscious of the
fact that the interim protection has
continued for a considerable period and
no allegation of misuse of such
protection or non-cooperation on the
part of the applicant has been brought to
the notice of the Court. In these
circumstances, and particularly when
the investigation already stands
concluded and the charge-sheet has
been filed, this Court finds no compelling
reason to disturb the protection from
arrest already extended to the applicant.
11. Accordingly, having regard to the
facts and circumstances of the case, the
nature of the allegations, the conduct of
the applicant during the period of
interim protection, the completion of
investigation and submission of the
charge-sheet, this Court is of the
considered view that the interim
protection granted to the applicant vide
order dated 10.06.2025 deserves to be
confirmed.

UKHC010079172025
2026:UHC:8819
13. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail
application is allowed. The interim
anticipatory bail granted to the applicant
vide order dated 10.06.2025 is hereby
made absolute. In the event of arrest, the
applicant shall be released on
anticipatory bail on the same terms and
conditions as contained in the order
dated 10.06.2025. The applicant shall
continue to abide by the said terms and
conditions and shall also remain subject
to any further condition which may be
imposed by the trial court in accordance
with law.
14. It is made clear that the
observations made in this order are
confined to the consideration of the
present anticipatory bail application and
shall not be construed as an expression
of opinion on the merits of the case. The
trial court shall consider the case
independently and decide the same
strictly on the basis of the evidence
brought on record and in accordance
with law.
15. Pending application(s), if any, also
stand disposed of.
(Alok Mahra, J.)
